newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks lifted in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks lifted in active trade.

text.p: Most Croatian stocks rose on Thursday in active trade, with buyers continuing to go for Zagrebacka Banka.
* Of 16 issues 11 rose, three fell and two were flat.
* Volume rose to 24,784 from 13,554 units, turnover jumped to 33.4 from 14.7 million kuna.
* Top gainer shipper Jadroplov added 55 kuna or almost 58 percent from late in May to 150 kuna, on volume of 322 shares.
* Biggest decliner was hotelier Suncani Hvar, losing one kuna or 1.8 percent to 54 kuna with 332 shares sold.
* Most active issue Zagrebacka ordinaries fell 25 kuna to close at 2,035 although most of the 13,741 shares were sold at 2,050-2,070 kuna.
